name: io.github.allooloo/getasof
title: Allooloo As Of
description: The issuer record as of any date, from the sealed vintage: signed and receipted (RCO-10060).

tools.name: get_as_of
tools.description: get_as_of is the issuer record as it stood on a date: an issuer by ticker, ISIN or LEI plus a date returns the signed record of that day — every field with its source and read date, the sealed disclosure lines of the market-year up to that date — signed by the node of the issuer's market and receipted, so a backtest can show what it read and when. Nothing is restated and nothing is filled backwards: before the record existed the answer says before_record; in a market-year not yet sealed it says not_sealed and names the earliest sealed date. Served from the Replay store under Data Vintage (sealed market-years, 2021 forward); typed errors unknown_issuer, before_record, not_sealed, not_found; every answer carries the node signature (kid) and its RCO-10060 receipt (verify_receipt at https://mcp.rco-records.ai/mcp).

issuer.description: Ticker (with exchange where it helps: NASDAQ:AAPL, SHEL.L), ISIN or LEI.

as_of.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD: the day the record is read as of.

market.description: Optional two-letter market code; the owning node resolves it if absent.

tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI. The router names the issuer's home market and forwards to that market's MCP for the record summary.

identifier.description: Ticker with or without exchange (SHOP, TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L, BHP.AX, D05.SI, NESN.SW, SAP.DE, 7203.T, 005930.KS), ISIN, LEI, an exact legal name or a sourced alias.

tools.name: list_events_since
tools.description: Dated disclosure events for an issuer since a date, each with its source address, served by the MCP of the issuer's home market.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Every market on the roster (nodes.json, with its region), which are live, and each market's MCP and agent card.
